subject: values
title: The Friends Who Helped
objective: Recognize helping behavior: identify when a character helps a friend and choose to help in a scenario.

story_beats.text: In the Panchatantra, a little mouse chewed through a net to free the lion. The lion had laughed at the tiny mouse — but the mouse helped anyway.
Tara closes her sketchbook. 'Helping doesn't need you to be big. It needs you to CARE. Let's practise!'

interactions.prompt: Your friend drops their crayons. What do you do?
The mouse helped the lion even though the lion laughed at him. That was...

hint_sequence: Look at each choice, one by one.
Tara points at the two closest choices.
transfer_question: Tell a grown-up about a time you helped — or could help — a friend.

feedback.correct: You chose kindness — just like the little mouse!
feedback.retry: Hmm, what would the kind mouse do? Try again!

off_screen: Do one helpful thing today without being asked. Notice how it feels.
parent_note: Values: helping, kindness. Scenario-based moral reasoning.
